source_context: After the independent Kochen-Stone submission had passed the LeanFrontier receiver and was frozen for upstream review, the human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT re-read the live contribution-directions document and chose the independent Furstenberg-topology algebra direction rather than stack on an unmerged probability PR. The producer inspected the accepted LeanFrontier.Topology.Furstenberg module and Mathlib's topological-group and basis APIs, and found no equivalent Furstenberg-topology development in Mathlib. The selected first milestone is the algebraic core: prove negation and addition continuous for the named Furstenberg topology and bundle those proofs as a named AddGroupTopology on the integers without replacing the ordinary global topology instance. The proof uses explicit preimage identities for arithmetic progressions: negation maps a residue class to the opposite residue class, while the preimage of a residue class under addition is a union of products of residue classes. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored the Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
